project.name: llmgw-idempotency
project.description: Customer idempotency-key subsystem (Chapter-9 9.2.4/9.5.4, CONTEXT.md and ADR-0007): explicit per-project call de-duplication. Same key + same request digest within the TTL window replays the original identifiers without resubmitting upstream; same key with a different digest is rejected; in-flight and unknown-outcome calls never expire into a new submission. This store provides防重 only — no SSE replay, no exactly-once promise; amounts are out of scope (pure strings plus epoch-ms stamps).
